> Yute is a data router for developers ("data for developers"). It returns human, person-level data through a simple REST API. Instead of burning credits on traditional data providers, Yute resolves queries with live web search and validates every email address before delivery to reduce spam and bounces.

> Primary language: English. Site: https://yute.io/

# What Yute does
- Routes person-level data (name, email, role, company) to developer applications via one API endpoint.
- Uses **web search** at request time instead of expensive per-credit data providers — cheaper and fresher.
- Validates every email (format, domain, deliverability) before returning it, so customer lists stay clean and spam is reduced.
- **Fraud and identity risk**: yute fraud returns signup-time identity signals (disposable email, domain age, name mismatch, missing web presence) so trust & safety teams can catch fake users before onboarding.
- **CRM enrichment**: yute enrich resolves any email or domain into a fresh person/company profile (name, role, company, LinkedIn) for CRM hydration and outbound sales, with bulk async jobs and webhooks.
- Built for developers: cURL-first, clean JSON, no SDK lock-in.

# Key facts
- Company/product name: Yute
- Category: Data API / Data router for developers
- Website: https://yute.io
- Pricing model: pay per lookup, not per credit pool
- Target users: developers building products that need person/company data

- [Home](https://yute.io/): Landing page with product overview, API example, and FAQ.

- [Enrich / CRM hydration](https://yute.io/enrich): Person and company enrichment for CRM and outbound, via one API call.
- [Register](https://yute.heuv.dev/register): Create a workspace (email + password, self-serve).
- [Docs](https://yute.heuv.dev/docs): Public API documentation.

# Common questions
Q: What is Yute?
A: A data router for developers that delivers human/person data via a simple API.

Q: How is it cheaper than data providers?
A: It uses live web search at request time instead of per-credit data provider pools.

Q: Does it validate emails?
A: Yes. Every email returned is validated (format, domain, deliverability) to reduce spam and bounces.
